title: Integrative System Biology Analysis of Transcriptomic Responses to Drought Stress in Soybean (Glycine max L.).
authors: Shahriari, Amir Ghaffar; Soltani, Zahra; Tahmasebi, Aminallah; Poczai, Peter
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组共表达和PPI网络分析大豆干旱响应基因及转录因子，但仅涉及启动子CRE统计，无蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Drought is a major abiotic stressor that causes yield losses and limits the growing area for most crops. Soybeans are an important legume crop that is sensitive to water-deficit conditions and suffers heavy yield losses from drought stress. To improve drought-tolerant soybean cultivars through breeding, it is necessary to understand the mechanisms of drought tolerance in soybeans. In this study, we applied several transcriptome datasets obtained from soybean plants under drought stress in comparison to those grown under normal conditions to identify novel drought-responsive genes and their underlying molecular mechanisms. We found 2168 significant up/downregulated differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and 8 core modules using gene co-expression analysis to predict their biological roles in drought tolerance. Gene Ontology and KEGG analyses revealed key biological processes and metabolic pathways involved in drought tolerance, such as photosynthesis, glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase and cytokinin dehydrogenase activity, and regulation of systemic acquired resistance. Genome-wide analysis of plants' cis-acting regulatory elements (CREs) and transcription factors (TFs) was performed for all of the identified DEG promoters in soybeans. Furthermore, the PPI network analysis revealed significant hub genes and the main transcription factors regulating the expression of drought-responsive genes in each module. Among the four modules associated with responses to drought stress, the results indicated that GLYMA_04G209700, GLYMA_02G204700, GLYMA_06G030500, GLYMA_01G215400, and GLYMA_09G225400 have high degrees of interconnection and, thus, could be considered as potential candidates for improving drought tolerance in soybeans. Taken together, these findings could lead to a better understanding of the mechanisms underlying drought responses in soybeans, which may useful for engineering drought tolerance in plants.
abstract_zh: 干旱是一种主要的非生物胁迫因子，导致大多数作物减产并限制其种植面积。大豆是一种重要的豆科作物，对缺水条件敏感，并因干旱胁迫遭受严重产量损失。为了通过育种改良耐旱大豆品种，有必要了解大豆的耐旱机制。在本研究中，我们应用了从干旱胁迫下大豆植株获得的多个转录组数据集，并与正常条件下生长的植株进行比较，以识别新的干旱响应基因及其潜在的分子机制。我们通过基因共表达分析发现了2168个显著上调/下调的差异表达基因（DEGs）和8个核心模块，以预测它们在耐旱性中的生物学作用。基因本体论（Gene Ontology）和KEGG分析揭示了参与耐旱性的关键生物学过程和代谢途径，如光合作用、甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶和细胞分裂素脱氢酶活性，以及系统获得性抗性的调控。对所有鉴定出的大豆DEG启动子进行了全基因组范围的植物顺式作用调控元件（CREs）和转录因子（TFs）分析。此外，PPI网络分析揭示了显著的核心基因（hub genes）以及每个模块中调控干旱响应基因表达的主要转录因子。在与干旱胁迫响应相关的四个模块中，结果表明GLYMA_04G209700、GLYMA_02G204700、GLYMA_06G030500、GLYMA_01G215400和GLYMA_09G225400具有高度的互连性，因此可被视为改善大豆耐旱性的潜在候选基因。综上所述，这些发现有助于更深入地理解大豆干旱响应的潜在机制，这可能对植物耐旱性的工程改造有用。
